reason: A DSH bundle plugin centered on multi-engine web search, page fetching, X/Twitter search, and assisted deep-research workflows, with optional external API and credential integrations.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多引擎网页搜索、页面抓取、X/Twitter 搜索和深度研究工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with multi-engine web search, page fetching, X/Twitter search, and deep-research tools.

capabilities: Fetches and extracts web page content
Queries X/Twitter through credentialed or credential-free paths
Calls optional external APIs and local CLI tools
Stores search-layer and optional credential configuration locally
Runs in the host process and can invoke child processes
